title: NPM Package Information
description: Provides package details, version and download statistics, package comparisons, and alternatives using the npm registry.

supportedIntents.description: Retrieve details about a named npm package, including its latest version, description, weekly downloads, release date, license, repository, Node.js requirements, and deprecation status.
example: Show me the latest version of express
What is the license for lodash?

supportedIntents.description: Compare two or three npm packages using their published metadata and download statistics.
Find related npm packages or alternatives to a named package using npm registry search results.
example: Find npm packages for date formatting

type.description: Request type: package-details, package-comparison, or package-alternatives.

name.description: The npm package name or search topic.

features.description: Requested package fields, such as version, downloads, license, release date, repository, or alternatives.
